description:
FILED s470 (Fable, 2026-09-05) from the s470bn merge-review probe (scratch bn/probe.pl), identical on BN's tree in default AND PCL_OPT=none, so PRE-EXISTING (not symref-const's).

REPRO (perl 5.40.3 vs PCL):
  no strict 'refs'; our $g = 2;
  sub lc1 { local ${'main::g'} = 9; ${'g'} }
  print lc1(), " $g\n";
  perl: 9 2      PCL: (empty) 2

The localized store through a SYMBOLIC reference is lost (the read inside the scope sees undef); the restore is right (2 after).  Related: #1190 (local on a nested element with an undef intermediate loses the value) -- the same detached-place class on a different spelling; the local-element/local-symref path should route through the one vivifying accessor (rule 11).  Probe `local ${"main::g"}` (dq), `local @{'main::ga'}`, `local ${'g'}` (unqualified) too.  Companion: op/local.t, op/gv.t --jobs 1 before/after.

=== DONE (s473a, 2026-09-07, commit 5461cf87) ===
Pl::Parser::_process_local_declaration's symbolic-deref branch emitted the
save/restore macro and RETURNED â before it ever looked at the `=` â so the
assignment vanished on every sigil.  It now binds the RHS outside the open
(perl evaluates it BEFORE localizing: `local ${'g'} = ${'g'} + 1` is 2, probed)
and assigns inside it, with the PLACE from Pl::ExprToCL::_cast_form (the one
constructor every symbolic place goes through, so the `symref-const` memo
licence is decided in one place) and the WRITER from the same three-way pick
the @items solo-`deref` path makes (p-setf / p-array-deref-= / p-hash-deref-=).

A COMPUTED name is bound to a temporary the macro and the place share: the
first version evaluated it TWICE, and perl evaluates it once (`local ${ nm() }
= 5` calls nm once â probed).  A literal name needs no temporary and keeps its
memo.  A statement modifier gates the RHS, the save/restore and the assignment,
with the condition itself bound once.

Fourteen shapes byte-identical to perl 5.40.3 (scratch/s473a/probes/m3guard.pl,
the guard's own fixture): the three literal spellings, the unqualified one,
@{} and %{}, ${$var} / $$var / @{$var}, the old-value RHS, both modifier
branches, "a false modifier never evaluates the RHS", "the name runs once",
and the bare no-init spelling.

Bars: corpus-diff IDENTICAL over 111; gate 221/7637 (only the 13 pclxs xs
rows); full sweep GATE clean, TOTAL 18674 (+0), drops 5 = census; companion
--jobs 1 op/local.t op/multideref.t op/gv.t op/localref.t byte-identical on
this tree and on a 41ca2496 extraction, all four equal to their snapshot rows;
ir-conform 133-local left known-fail.tsv by EDIT (290/0/54/0).  Guard: one
block in Pl/t/local-symref-01.t (plan 8 -> 9), inverse-verified.

RESIDUE, filed as #1341: the SUBSCRIPTED spelling `local ${'main::gh'}{a} = 7`
reaches the same branch and is wrong twice over (it localizes the SCALAR
$main::gh, and drops the init).  Deliberately untouched â the init handling
fires only when the `=` follows the deref directly.
